dedupe_keys.name: ndvi nocturnal road traffic noise and traffic flow over the canton of geneva

description: An EPFL and University of Lausanne team publishes road-traffic noise, traffic-flow points and vegetation measures for the canton of Geneva. Zenodo lists public shapefile components and a text README under CC BY 4.0. The README defines a hectometric grid in Swiss LV95 coordinates, with daily and nocturnal noise, NDVI and land-surface-temperature summaries per cell, plus traffic-flow measurement locations. Landsat 8 imagery is dated June 2018; the traffic layer was extracted in November 2021 and reports a February 2021 source update. These layers can inform road-noise exposure or traffic-flow calibration in urban simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the combined grid and point layer. A limitation is that the vegetation–noise association is spatial correlation, not a validated causal attenuation coefficient. The provider removed null-flow points, so low-volume or missing areas may be underrepresented. No shapefile was downloaded and no cell statistic was recalculated.
